prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept production game assets.
Create ONE TRANSPARENT PNG SPRITE ATLAS for the Godot 2D top-down western game Tequila Kill, matching the reference's softly shaded pixel-art village. The reference is a STYLE AND OBJECT IDENTITY GUIDE, not an image to copy as a whole. Output production isolated sprites on genuine transparent alpha, NOT a scene or poster.
EXACT GRID: FIVE equal columns by FOUR equal rows = TWENTY cells, evenly spaced, one complete object centered in each cell. No overlapping cells, each object has generous transparent margin and is fully visible. No labels, cell outlines, background checkerboard or ground.
Camera is the same classic Zelda-like overhead projection as the reference: object tops visible, short frontal faces, orthogonal axes, not isometric and not side-view perspective. Crisp stepped pixel-art edges with simple broad soft-shaded volumes inside. Warm amber wood, cream adobe, brick-red cloth, desaturated clay, gold highlights, dark plum-brown selective outlines, minimal fine noise. Preserve the friendly simple art of the approved village. NO drawn cast shadows or floor under the objects; the engine will add contact shadows.
READ THE CELL ORDER LEFT TO RIGHT EACH ROW:
ROW 1: (1) intact light wooden CRATE, loose planks and a tiny corner chip, clearly fragile, no metal armor; (2) permanent sturdy wooden BARREL with two dark iron hoops, overhead circular top; (3) square permanent POKER TABLE viewed overhead with just a few cream cards/red chips; (4) permanent broad low BURGUNDY COUCH with three cushions and wooden ends; (5) breakable LIGHT WOOD CHAIR, slender legs/backrest, same warm edge highlight as crate.
ROW 2: (6) intact breakable TERRACOTTA POT with bright thin rim and a small subtle crack, clearly separate simple silhouette; (7) small permanent wooden CART with two wheels and two handles extending right; (8) permanent LONG HORIZONTAL BAR COUNTER, plain amber timber with thick dark base, width at least 4 times height; (9) CLOSED WOODEN HOUSE, warm plank facade, simple brown plank roof seen overhead, little closed front door/windows, small porch and steps, fully intact complete building like reference; (10) CLOSED CREAM ADOBE HOUSE, terracotta tile roof, little closed door/windows, small porch/steps, like reference.
ROW 3: (11) LONG HORIZONTAL GOODS SHELF with clay mugs and sacks, no green bottles; (12) simple HORIZONTAL WATER TROUGH full of muted blue water; (13) simple upright DESERT CACTUS with two short arms, pixel silhouette; (14) low cluster of THREE pale warm ROCKS with gentle facets, no floor; (15) small WALL TOOL RACK, two or three readable tools shovel/pick/rope on a short horizontal plank.
ROW 4: (16) short HORIZONTAL MUG SHELF with four simple cream mugs/clay jugs, no bottles; (17) BROKEN WOOD CRATE, same light boards as row1crate, collapsed pieces mostly still grouped, transparent floor gaps; (18) BROKEN LIGHT CHAIR, same design as row1chair, a few flat short planks; (19) SHATTERED TERRACOTTA POT, same clay as row2pot, low few curved shards with transparent gaps and one broken ring base; (20) LONG HORIZONTAL GENERAL STORE COUNTER with small gold BALANCE SCALE and one sack on top, heavy permanent base, recognizable as goods store not poker.
All twenty are separate reusable sprites, not twenty panels containing miniature rooms. Houses are larger on their own slots, not tiny houses inside scenery. Do not put a roof over the tables or counters. Do not add barrels beside a house. No people, weapons, bottle objective, text, numbers, UI, scenery, backdrop, ground, shadows, glow, watermarks or frame. The whole canvas background must be truly transparent.
